answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3097 Country: Bangladesh Title: My question is regarding keeping Beard in Islamic Shariah. Lots of Saudi Arabian people sport no beard at all, or if there is beard, then it's like French-cut. Is there anything special in permission for Saudi People? Please elaborate your answer with details from Qur'an and Hadiths. Question: Assalamu-alaikum, My question is regarding keeping Beard in Islamic Shariah. Lots of Saudi Arabian people sport no beard at all, or if there is beard, then it's like French-cut. Is there anything special in permission for Saudi People? Please elaborate your answer with details from Qur'an and Hadiths. Allah Hafiz. Answer ID: 3097 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 158/158/L) The command of keeping beard is common and it applies to all whether a Saudi or non-Saudi: عن ابن عمر رضی اللہ عنھما قال: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: خالفوا المشرکین؛ اوفروا اللحی و احفوا الشوارب، وفی روایۃ انھکوا الشوارب و اعفوا اللحی (مشکاۃ: 2/380 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
